summary: Verified all new features: parallel job fetching (100 jobs in ~2s), /api/jobs/saved endpoint, job caching to MongoDB, is_new_for_user flag, Dashboard saved jobs section with NEW star badges, and Find New Jobs navigation. All 18 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified with Playwright.
passed_tests: Backend: Auth endpoint working with test session
Backend: Parallel job fetching completes in <10 seconds (actual: ~2s for 100 jobs)
Backend: Streaming returns jobs progressively with heartbeat/progress messages
Backend: /api/jobs/saved endpoint exists and returns proper structure
Backend: /api/jobs/saved requires authentication (401 without token)
Backend: /api/jobs/saved returns user's saved jobs
Backend: Job search saves results to user_saved_jobs collection
Backend: New jobs marked with is_new_for_user flag when compared to previous cache
Backend: Saved jobs limited to top 50 for dashboard
Backend: Dashboard stats endpoint returns proper data
Backend: Fallback search still works with parallel fetching
Frontend: Dashboard loads with authentication
Frontend: 'Your Saved Jobs' section displays with job cards
Frontend: NEW badge with star icon shows on new jobs (amber colored)
Frontend: '50 New' badge shows count of new jobs
Frontend: Last search info displayed (query, location, date)
Frontend: Match scores displayed on job cards (70%, 36%, 48%, etc.)
Frontend: 'Find New Jobs' button navigates to /jobs page
Frontend: Job search page loads and shows 'Found 100 jobs matched to your profile'
Frontend: Quality Boards source selector works
Frontend: Job cards show company, location, employment type, posted date
critical_code_review_comments: Parallel fetching implementation is efficient: fetch_all_jobs_parallel() uses asyncio.gather with batch size of 20
Job caching properly saves to both job_cache and user_saved_jobs collections
is_new_for_user flag correctly compares against existing_job_ids from previous cache
Dashboard.jsx properly fetches and displays saved jobs with NEW indicators
seed_data_creation: Created test user with Software Engineer profile: skills (Python, JavaScript, SQL, AWS, React), job_titles (Software Engineer, Full Stack Developer), preferred_locations (Toronto, Remote), experience_years (5)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features verified working: 1) Parallel job fetching reduced load time from 35-60s to ~2s, 2) /api/jobs/saved endpoint returns saved jobs for dashboard, 3) Jobs are cached to MongoDB after each search, 4) is_new_for_user flag marks new jobs compared to previous cache, 5) Dashboard shows 'Your Saved Jobs' section with NEW star badges on new jobs, 6) 'Find New Jobs' button navigates to job search page. Test session valid for 7 days.
